milestone: SeLinOS opaque lease capability transfer M1

contract.request: The probe may send only the exact two-word opaque-token request for slot 1.
contract.transfer: Objectd returns exactly one root-preprovisioned notification cap; taskd configures a predeclared CNode receive path, validates an exact one-extra-cap reply and signals success.
contract.authority: The token is an opaque notification cap. No object, TCB, CSpace, VSpace, page table, frame, stack, mapping, device or allocator capability is transferred.

required_markers: SeLinOS taskd opaque lease M1: exact slot 1 request accepted.
SeLinOS objectd opaque lease M1: one notification token transferred to taskd.
SeLinOS taskd opaque lease M1: opaque notification token received; no resource created.
SeLinOS taskd opaque lease M1 probe: fixed token transfer passed.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS taskd opaque lease M1: malformed client request rejected.
SeLinOS taskd opaque lease M1: reply label or length rejected.
SeLinOS taskd opaque lease M1: reply extra-cap count rejected.
SeLinOS taskd opaque lease M1: reply status rejected.

not_claimed: actual resource, object, TCB, CSpace, VSpace, page-table, frame, stack or mapping lease transfer
dynamic child creation, child configuration, start, resume, teardown, release or reuse
executable mapping, W^X, native ELF loading or dynamic linker semantics
Linux clone, fork, pthread, process exit, wait, signal or futex semantics
device, IRQ, DMA, PCI, I/O or IOSpace authority
